name: Affine pattern noise (bias added to Gaussian)
plain: Takes standard noise and adds a procedural pattern as an offset, then clamps to ±3. Pattern can be normalized first. Variance rises by the pattern's contribution, less what the clamp cuts.
math: base=prepare_noise. m=pattern; if normalize: m=(m−μ)/std. result = clamp(base + m·affine_scale·affine_bias, −3, 3).
label: from code
surprise: scale and bias multiply each other, so bias=0 disables all patterns (affine_nodes.py:1668).

audit.note: Omits the final clamp: affine_nodes.py:1672 and the 4D branch return result.clamp_(-3,3), and the no-op path clamps base noise too. Variance is not simply increased, since tails are cut.
